scope: Authoritative index of primary stored CARDIODIAG artifacts; archived notebook outputs are excluded.

primary_internal_protocol.selection_rule: model selection occurs inside inner folds; outer folds are used only for final evaluation

status_definitions.COMPLETED_AND_VERIFIED: Artifact parses, provenance/hash checks pass, and the documented protocol was executed successfully.
status_definitions.COMPLETED_BUT_NOT_INDEPENDENTLY_VERIFIED: Artifact is present and internally checked, but has not been independently rerun or is bounded/superseded evidence.
status_definitions.EXPLORATORY: Completed analysis outside the primary CARDIODIAG endpoint.
status_definitions.HISTORICAL: Archived or pre-correction evidence; never pooled with corrected results.
status_definitions.INCOMPLETE: Attempted workflow did not finish or lacks a complete result artifact.
status_definitions.FAILED: Execution failed and the failure is retained as part of the audit trail.

external_validation.reason: No genuinely independent compatible dataset is frozen.
